Закройте её полностью — не только окно,: Close it completely — not just the window, but also the icon by the clock (right-click → exit). If it's set to run at startup, disable that, or it will come back after a reboot. Then turn the bypass on here.
VPN заворачивает весь трафик в свой тунн: A VPN wraps all traffic into its tunnel. The engine edits packets after that, and they reach the provider sealed inside the tunnel — there's nothing left to bypass, so the bypass looks broken even if the strategy is correct.
Отключитесь от VPN, пока пользуетесь обх: Disconnect from the VPN while you use the bypass. The bypass solves the same problem as a VPN — you don't need both together. If the VPN is required for work, use them one at a time, not at once.
Сетевой адаптер туннеля включён. Такое б: A tunnel network adapter is enabled. This happens even with the VPN client closed: the adapter stays in the system and keeps diverting some traffic past the engine.
Выйдите из VPN-клиента полностью. Если а: Quit the VPN client completely. If the adapter is left over from an already-uninstalled program, disable it: Windows Settings → Network & Internet → Advanced network settings → select the adapter → “Disable”.
winws2 — это то, что собственно обходит: winws2 is what actually bypasses the block; without it the “Enable the bypass” button won't work. It usually downloads itself on the first launch, so if it still isn't there, the download failed.
Откройте «Настройки» → «Проверить обновл: Open “Settings” → “Check for updates” and wait for the download to finish. If it fails with a network error, the cause is your provider blocking githubusercontent.com: the app already tries to get around it via DoH, but the most reliable option is to turn on a VPN just for this one download, then turn it off.
Сам winws2 на месте, но часть файлов отс: winws2 itself is in place, but some files are missing — usually the WinDivert filter set that appeared in newer versions. Strategies that use them won't start.
«Настройки» → «Проверить обновления». Не: “Settings” → “Check for updates”. The missing files download over the current version; there's no need to reinstall or delete anything.

Преграды две, и они разные. Обход снимае: There are two obstacles, and they are different. The bypass removes the first: your provider will not let you reach the site. Packets are rewritten and the connection gets through. The address you arrive from stays yours.
Вторая преграда — сам сайт. Он смотрит,: The second obstacle is the site itself. It looks at the address you came from and checks its reputation. Russian home ranges score badly with anti-fraud systems: a lot of bots and abuse come from them, and the low score lands on the whole range at once rather than on the individual offender.
Адреса WARP принадлежат Cloudflare, а че: WARP's addresses belong to Cloudflare, which carries a sizeable share of the whole web — its addresses sit very differently in those reputation lists. With the proxy on you arrive not from a suspect pool but as a Cloudflare client, and the very same check lets you through.
Через прокси идёт только то, что вы в не: Only what you point at the proxy goes through it: a browser, a messenger. Everything else connects directly — or turn on “Send all system traffic through it” under Options. And keep the bypass running: Cloudflare has to be reached in the first place, and with the bypass the connection comes up first try, without it every other attempt.

Несколько звеньев подряд. Обход доводит: Several links in a row. The bypass gets you to the entrance, the entrance sets the country, and Cloudflare hands out an address that is trusted. A service sees the entrance's country rather than yours — which is what cures «not available in your region», against which a bypass can do nothing.
Как устроено подключение: How the connection is put together
Замерено: страну выхода Cloudflare выбир: MEASURED: Cloudflare picks the exit country from wherever the connection came from — the device and the keys stay the same. That is why the entrance decides everything. Tor alone will not do it: services know its exit addresses and refuse them.
Длинным путём идут только сайты из списк: Only the listed sites take the long way. Everything else — video, games, downloads — goes as usual, at full speed.
Отдельный выключатель: обычный прокси WA: A switch of its own: the ordinary WARP proxy on the next tab works by itself, at full speed, and does not go through the chain.
Сейчас выбран вход «Напрямую» — цепочки: The entrance is «Direct» at the moment — there is no chain, and the country will not change: the listed sites go through the ordinary WARP proxy, if it is on. For another country pick «Your proxy» or «Tor».
Звено, которое задаёт страну. Свой прокс: The link that sets the country. Your own proxy if you have one, Tor if you do not.

Спросить мосты у Tor Project и найти обы: Ask the Tor Project for bridges and find ordinary relays this network can reach
Кнопка берёт мосты у Tor Project и заодн: The button asks the Tor Project for bridges and also looks for ordinary relays that answer from your network: they carry no obfuscation and are often faster than bridges. You can still paste your own lines — the @GetBridgesBot bot hands them out.
Без закрепления Tor берёт новый узел на: Without a pin Tor takes a new node for every connection — to a service that is a new visitor every time. A pin also allows a second connection to Cloudflare, because both then share one address. MEASURED: nodes with similar consensus bandwidth differed fifteenfold in real speed.
При первом включении программа скачает T: The first time it is switched on the program downloads Tor — 21 MB, through WARP itself: the Tor site is blocked in Russia. The bypass on the Home tab has to be running — while a chain through Tor is on it covers every site rather than just the lists, or the bridges do not connect.
Вести эти сайты через цепочку: Send these sites through the chain
Правило подхватывают Chrome, Edge, Brave: Chrome, Edge, Brave and anything built on them pick the rule up — that is what it was checked on; Firefox has not been tested. The shipped list is the AI sites, because those are the ones that refuse by country — but the list is yours, put anything in it.
Пока цепочка включена, эти сайты идут то: While the chain is on these sites go through it and nowhere else: if the entrance drops they stop opening rather than leave from your own address. Switch the chain off and the rule is removed — they go out as usual, from your own address, so better stay out of an account tied to another country then.
Сюда — адреса, с которых грузятся только: Put here the addresses that serve nothing but images and scripts. MEASURED: the grok.com page makes 219 requests and 188 of them go to cdn.grok.com, where a country means nothing. What is listed here goes past the chain as usual; the site itself stays in it.
Не страхует аккаунт. Правила сервисов ни: It does not insure an account. The services' own rules still apply, signing up for Claude asks for a phone number from a supported country, and a sudden change of country can get an account reviewed. Changing the address answers «they will not let me in», not «am I allowed».
И не делает быстро. Через Tor замерено 2: Nor does it make things fast. Through Tor it measured 2–6 Mbit/s with about a second of latency: fine for a conversation, noticeable for files. That is why the list is kept short.
Страну сам WARP не меняет: бесплатный вы: WARP by itself does not change the country: the free service exits through the nearest node, so from Russia the address is Russian. What changes is the address's reputation. For «not available in your region» there is the HMS tab — there Cloudflare is reached from another country, and the exit lands in that country too.
